text:
anya: quick sanity check — planning to land header-based SDK gating for the new compact_kv inferencing path. plan: SDKs send X-RW-SDK-Flags header with semicolon-separated flags; server routes by audience + min-sdk. need guardrails and rollout plan.

matt: nice. can you paste exact header format & fallback behavior?

anya: suggested header: `X-RW-SDK-Flags: compact_kv=on;min_sdk=1.6.0;audience=canary`
server-side: verify semver >= min_sdk then route to `runtime-compact-kv` image. fallback: invalid header or semver fail -> route to `runtime-default`. we'll enforce runtime-level kill-switch too. also telemetry tag `x-rw-canary=true` for traces.

kai: percentage split? hashing?

anya: default 5% by cust-id. hashing: `sha256(customer_id + server_salt) % 100 < N`. for no-id use IP-hash; if IP not present -> 0% (safest). region-scoped canary: us-east only at first.

olivia: mobile concern — older SDKs could try to forge header. min_sdk blocks legit older sdks but can't stop spoofing if auth header is reused. we require auth + tls; consider also verifying `User-Agent` pattern server-side as a soft check.

matt: add a global kill switch `sdk_compact_kv_enabled` in config. Rollout-bot should auto-disable if error_rate > 1% or p50_latency_increase_ms > 30 for a 10m window. also need fast manual rollback path.

devops-sara: i can add infra binding: prometheus alert + pd integration for `rollout/compact_kv`. will create Prom rule for error_rate and latency regression. where's the PR?

anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8923 — server router + telemetry + docs stub. awaiting reviews from @matt @kai. server change is small but touches router and metrics.

matt: :eyes: i'll review today. QA: include integration test that asserts header parsing, hashing bucketing, and fallback when min_sdk fails. also add an e2e with trace tag present.

kai: adding unit tests for header parsing. quick snippet i'm using: ```python
def parse_flags(h):
    parts = [p for p in h.split(';') if p]
    kv = {}
    for p in parts:
        k,v = p.split('=',1)
        kv[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    return kv
```
will add semver parse + validation and tests for malformed headers.

olivia: docs/devex: i'll draft an SDK note and example snippets for Node/Python. also include migration notes for SDK teams and a feature-gating checklist.

anya: deploy plan proposal: canary 5% (us-east) 24h -> 20% 48h -> 100% if metrics stable. automatic rollback triggers as matt suggested. manual rollback via console toggle within 15m. any objections to region restriction?

matt: 👍 no objections. add a stage to smoke test inference outputs on canary to detect quality regressions (not just latency/errors).

anya: good call — will add a small eval suite to the canary flow.

rollout-bot: rollout/compact_kv: canary enabled for 5% in us-east by anya at 1764003000 :shipit:

anya: thanks all — i'll merge PR after matt + kai reviews and ping docs team @olivia to publish the SDK note. tagging followups in the PR. :thumbsup:
